❯ Use the Edit tool to replace the line beta with the line delta in notes.txt. Do not use Bash.

⏺ Update(notes.txt)
  ⎿  Rejected update to notes.txt
      1  alpha
      2 -beta
      2 +delta
      3  gamma

❯ Use the Write tool to create a new file named hello.txt containing exactly two lines: hi and bye. Do not use Bash.

⏺ Write(hello.txt)
  ⎿  Rejected write to hello.txt
      1 hi
      2 bye
